definitions.gloss: low altitude; low in the sky
definitions.explanation: A position relatively close to the ground. Used for aircraft, flying objects, and figuratively for performing at a minimal level.

examples.japanese: ヘリコプターが{低空|ていくう}{飛行|ひこう}していた。
examples.english: A helicopter was flying at low altitude.

examples.japanese: {今学期|こんがっき}の{成績|せいせき}は{低空|ていくう}飛行だったが、なんとか{単位|たんい}は{取|と}れた。
examples.english: My grades this semester were just barely scraping by, but I managed to earn my credits.

notes:
USAGE:
{低空|ていくう}{飛行|ひこう} (low-altitude flight) is the most common compound. It is also used figuratively to mean barely getting by or performing at the minimum acceptable level.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {低空|ていくう}{飛行|ひこう} (low-altitude flight; barely scraping by)
- {低空|ていくう}で{飛|と}ぶ (to fly low)
- {低空|ていくう}{侵入|しんにゅう} (low-altitude intrusion)
